title: A Day at School: Instructions & Story
summary: Listen to short teacher instructions, morning bell routines, and playful tales.
outcome: Follow two-step verbal directions and understand key details in spoken stories.

activities.prompt: Teacher says: "Good morning, children! Please open your English books to page five and take out your pencils."
What page did the teacher ask the children to open?
activities.explanation: The teacher said: "open your English books to page five".

activities.prompt: What did the teacher ask students to take out?
activities.explanation: The teacher asked students to take out their pencils.

title: My Daily Routine & Action Chants
summary: Speak about waking up, brushing teeth, and asking polite questions in school.
outcome: Speak 3-to-4 word sentences clearly and request assistance using "May I...".

activities.prompt: Say clearly: "May I drink water, please?"
Recite with rhythm: "This is the way we wash our hands, wash our hands, wash our hands!"

turns.speaker: Aman
turns.text: Can I borrow your sharpener, Sunita?

title: The Mango Tree in the Village
summary: Read about birds nesting in a big green mango tree near Raipur village.
outcome: Read a 50-word story aloud with correct pauses and identify main characters.

activities.prompt: In our village, there is a big mango tree. In summer, sweet yellow mangoes grow on its branches. Two green parrots built a cozy nest in the tree. Every morning, the parrots sing sweet songs.
What kind of fruit grows on the tree in summer?
activities.passage: In summer, sweet yellow mangoes grow on its branches.
activities.explanation: The passage mentions sweet yellow mangoes.

items.text: There is a big mango tree in the village.
Green parrots built a cozy nest.
Every morning, the parrots sing sweet songs.

title: Sentence Builder: Capital Letters & Full Stops
summary: Form complete sentences starting with a capital letter and ending with a full stop.
outcome: Assemble scrambled words into meaningful sentences with proper punctuation.

activities.prompt: Arrange the words correctly: "likes / Rohan / apples / sweet"
activities.explanation: "Rohan likes sweet apples." follows Subject-Verb-Object order.

activities.prompt: Choose the sentence written with correct capital letter and full stop:
activities.explanation: Sentences must begin with a capital letter and end with a full stop.

activities.prompt: Fill in the blank: The sun ___ in the sky.

title: Position Words: In, On, Under & Behind
summary: Learn spatial prepositions (in, on, under, behind) and pronouns (He, She, It, They).
outcome: Identify the spatial location of objects using simple prepositions.

activities.prompt: The ball is ___ the table. (resting on its surface)
activities.explanation: When an object rests on top of a surface, use "on".

activities.prompt: The puppy is sleeping ___ the bed. (below the bed)
Pooja is a smart girl. ___ reads every day.
activities.explanation: Use the pronoun "She" for a female person.

title: Words for Home, Family & Animals
summary: Build everyday vocabulary for family relationships, rooms, and baby animals.
outcome: Match animals with their young ones (cow/calf, dog/puppy, cat/kitten).

activities.prompt: Match each mother animal with its baby:
Spell the word for where we sleep (starts with "b"):
What do we call our mother's brother?
activities.explanation: Our mother's brother is our uncle.
